title: Cache chaos injection and recovery runbook for KV/prefix cache resilience
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Follow-up for recent KV/prefix cache incidents: define deterministic chaos-injection tests, a staged recovery runbook, and telemetry gating to prevent recurrence. Goal is to make incidents reproducible in CI, reduce time-to-recovery in production, and provide safe automated mitigation hooks (quarantine + gradual rollback) while minimizing risk to tenant isolation.
action_items: Create CI chaos suite reproducing eviction storm and prefix corruption scenarios - owner: Marco Silva - due: 2026-03-01
Instrument per-tenant memory and eviction telemetry with per-shard histograms and sample payload captures - owner: Jun Park - due: 2026-03-08
Implement safety 'quarantine' toggles to quiesce misbehaving tenants without full node drain - owner: Priya Desai - due: 2026-03-12
Publish step-by-step recovery runbook with commands, dashboards, and rollback criteria - owner: Aisha Raman - due: 2026-03-15
Land a graceful rollback path that snapshots prefix index and allows incremental replay to avoid ghost-entries - owner: Diego Alvarez - due: 2026-03-18
Add automated alert run levels and paging thresholds tied to eviction-rate and checksum mismatch rate - owner: Mei Lin - due: 2026-03-05
Run two staged chaos experiments in canary and prod-sim clusters and capture diff telemetry - owner: Marco Silva - due: 2026-03-20
acceptance_criteria: Chaos suite reliably reproduces at least two historical failure modes in CI with <30m debug time
Runbook documents exactly when to quarantine a tenant vs start full node drain, and has tested playbook steps in staging
Alerting thresholds reduce loud pages for known non-actionable noise and escalate real incidents with correct tags
Quarantine toggle can be applied per-tenant and reverses without cache-corruption in 95% of test runs
Telemetry captures 1% sample of payloads (obfuscated) for memory/eviction forensics
PRs for CI tests and telemetry instrumentation merged and validated in canary
comments: 2026-02-16 Aisha Raman: Kickoff meeting - agreed that deterministic repro is primary win. Decided to focus on eviction storm + prefix-index corruption combos. Marco to prototype a fault injector by 2026-02-23.

2026-02-20 Marco Silva: Pushed initial chaos harness prototype to GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kvcache-chaos/pull/12 - uses controlled eviction pressure and interleaved compaction. Needs authz review before running against prod-sim.

2026-02-22 Jun Park: Telemetry schema proposal posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CRI/KV+Telemetry+Schema - includes per-shard eviction-rate, checksum-mismatch-rate, and sampled entry digests.

2026-02-24 Priya Desai: Design for tenant quarantine toggle drafted. Trade-off: quarantine avoids node-wide drain but may increase latency for healthy tenants on same shard if not isolated. Proposal includes gradual flow-control and quota limit.

2026-02-28 Mei Lin: Alert burn-in results: default thresholds produced 8 noisy pages in 24h; adjusted to percentile-based thresholds and added debouncing. Want product sign-off on customer-facing docs.

2026-03-02 Diego Alvarez: Implemented snapshot-and-replay prototype for prefix index; initial tests show 92% successful incremental replay without ghost entries on 10k-entry prefixes. Edge cases remain for partially-applied compaction.

2026-03-05 Aisha Raman: Review feedback from SRE: require a post-quarantine validation step that runs a background cache-sweep to detect corrupted tombstones before resuming writes. Added to action items.

2026-03-09 Marco Silva: Ran first staged chaos in canary cluster. Observed eviction-price oscillation when quarantine applied globally; fixed by scoping quarantine to tenant shard and adding backpressure. Telemetry dashboards captured the event: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/kv-chaos/eviction-playback
2026-03-11 Priya Desai: UX for runbook checklist reviewed by On-Call rotation. Suggest adding explicit rollback command snippets and expected timing at each step. Will update the Confluence doc.

2026-03-12 Aisha Raman: Marking ticket 'In Progress' with tasks split. Next: iterate CI tests and schedule a second chaos run in prod-sim next week. Customer comms draft prepared for incidents where quarantine will be used.
